admission.justification: Reusing completed validation instead of definitions would hide a later finding even when the parser optimization itself is correct.

applicability: Validation, census and anchor observations that share definition extraction during one call.
conditions: Only parsed definitions and eligible test-case diagnostic trees are shared.
exclusions: Caching a completed validator, census, worklist or quality result as a substitute for its independent pass.

evidence: Frozen W2 source, tree3149be148b3cfa3131e34f6101b07eba1ebd0080; remaining-hunk-reconciliation.json records exact checked ranges.

statement: Repeated checks retain their independent validation and census passes while sharing source definitions inside their call.
